network.num_cities: <int> Number of cities in the airline network.
network.city_names: <list[str], length num_cities> Name of each city in the network.
network.num_legs: <int> Number of flight legs in the network.

legs.leg_id: <int> Unique identifier for this flight leg.
legs.origin: <str> City where this flight leg departs.
legs.destination: <str> City where this flight leg arrives.
legs.capacity: <int> Number of available seats on this flight leg.

products.origin_destination: <str> Route of the itinerary, with intermediate stops separated by arrows.
products.fare: <float> Revenue earned per unit sold of this product.
products.legs_used: <list[int]> Leg IDs of the flight legs consumed by one unit of this product.

segments.segment_id: <int> Unique identifier for this customer segment.
segments.lambda_l: <float> Arrival rate of customers in this segment per period.
segments.consideration_set: <list[int]> Product IDs that customers in this segment would consider purchasing.
segments.preference_vector: <list[float], length len(consideration_set)> Preference weight of each product in the consideration set, in the same order.
segments.no_purchase_preference: <float> Preference weight for the no-purchase option for customers in this segment.
segments.description: <str> Brief label describing the segment's market and price sensitivity.

booking_horizon.T: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the booking horizon.

alpha: <float> Capacity scarcity factor used to scale leg capacities.
lambda: <float> Overall probability that a customer arrives in any single period.
